Landing.heroTitle:
Control Your AI Agents,
Not Just Manage Them
Landing.heroSubtitle: Human-in-the-loop workflows for AI agents. Auto-execute, manual approve, full audit trail — built for teams that need AI power without the risk.
Landing.feature1Desc: Your AI Agent performs the work automatically — data entry, content generation, customer responses.
Landing.feature2Desc: Before anything goes live, a human reviews and approves. No rogue AI actions.
Landing.feature3Desc: Every action logged, every decision tracked. Compliance-ready out of the box.
Landing.step1Desc: Pick a template or define your own. Connect AI agents to your tasks.
Landing.step2Desc: AI executes tasks, generates content, processes data — in real time.
Landing.step3Desc: Review outputs, make changes, approve with one click.
Landing.step4Desc: Approved content/actions go out. Everything is logged for audit.
Landing.testimonial1: WorkflowGuard let us deploy AI agents with confidence. The approval flow is exactly what we needed.
Landing.testimonial2: We used to spend hours on content review. Now it takes minutes — and we catch mistakes before they go live.
Landing.testimonial3: The audit trail alone is worth it. Our compliance team loves it.
Landing.faq1A: Yes. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit. Full audit logs, role-based access control, and GDPR-ready compliance.
Landing.faq2Q: Can I use WorkflowGuard without coding?
Landing.faq2A: Absolutely. Choose from pre-built templates, or create your own workflow visually. No coding required.
Landing.faq3Q: What AI tools can I integrate?
Landing.faq3A: WorkflowGuard works with any AI agent or API — OpenAI, Claude, custom LLMs, and more.
Landing.faq4A: Free tier includes up to 100 executions/month. Professional plans start at $29/month for teams that need more.
Landing.faq5A: Yes. Export all workflows, tasks, and audit logs anytime. No vendor lock-in.
Landing.bottomCta: Ready to control your AI agents?
